```{r cars}
# =========================
# Full 147-sample RNA-seq setup
# Keep only Day 1, 3, 5, 7
# Build DESeq2 + VST object
# =========================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(DESeq2)

# =========================
# 1) File paths
# =========================

counts_path  <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/featureCounts_HGNC_3.27.26.csv"
coldata_path <- "/Users/chhugani/coldata_clean_3.30.26.csv"

# =========================
# 2) Helper function to clean sample IDs
# =========================

clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- gsub("\r", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- sub("\\.bam$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_sorted$", "", x)
  x <- sub("^HH0*", "", x)
  x
}

# =========================
# 3) Load counts and metadata
# =========================

counts_raw <- read.csv(
  counts_path,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coldata <- read.csv(
  coldata_path,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Counts dimensions:", dim(counts_raw), "\n")
cat("Coldata dimensions:", dim(coldata), "\n")

# =========================
# 4) Prepare count matrix
# =========================

# First column is gene symbol/ID
gene_ids <- counts_raw$Gene

cts <- counts_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE]

# Clean sample names
colnames(cts) <- clean_sample_id(colnames(cts))

# Convert counts to numeric integers
cts <- as.data.frame(cts)

cts[] <- lapply(cts, function(x) {
  as.integer(round(as.numeric(x)))
})

# Use gene names as rownames
rownames(cts) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_ids))

# =========================
# 5) Prepare metadata
# =========================

names(coldata) <- trimws(names(coldata))

coldata$Sample <- clean_sample_id(coldata$Sample)

# =========================
# 6) Match counts and metadata
# =========================

common <- intersect(colnames(cts), coldata$Sample)

cat("Samples in counts:", ncol(cts), "\n")
cat("Samples in coldata:", nrow(coldata), "\n")
cat("Common samples:", length(common), "\n")

missing_from_counts <- setdiff(coldata$Sample, colnames(cts))
missing_from_coldata <- setdiff(colnames(cts), coldata$Sample)

cat("Metadata samples missing from counts:", length(missing_from_counts), "\n")
cat("Counts samples missing from metadata:", length(missing_from_coldata), "\n")

print(missing_from_counts)
print(missing_from_coldata)

# Keep matched samples
cts_matched <- cts[, common, drop = FALSE]

coldata_matched <- coldata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% common) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, common))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(cts_matched), coldata_matched$Sample))

cat("Final matched counts:", dim(cts_matched), "\n")
cat("Final matched metadata:", dim(coldata_matched), "\n")

# =========================
# 7) Keep only Day 1, 3, 5, 7
# =========================

coldata_deseq <- coldata_matched %>%
  mutate(
    Day = as.numeric(as.character(Day))
  ) %>%
  filter(Day %in% c(1, 3, 5, 7))

cts_deseq <- cts_matched[, coldata_deseq$Sample, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(cts_deseq), coldata_deseq$Sample))

rownames(coldata_deseq) <- coldata_deseq$Sample

cat("Samples retained for Day 1/3/5/7:", ncol(cts_deseq), "\n")

table(unique(coldata_deseq[c("Subject", "Status")])$Status)

# =========================
# 8) Create DESeq2 object
# =========================

coldata_deseq$Status <- factor(
  coldata_deseq$Status,
  levels = c("Persistent", "Resolving")
)

coldata_deseq$Day <- factor(
  coldata_deseq$Day,
  levels = c(1, 3, 5, 7)
)

dds_full <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = as.matrix(cts_deseq),
  colData = coldata_deseq,
  design = ~ Status + Day + Status:Day
)

# =========================
# 9) Filter low-count genes
# =========================

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_full) >= 10) >= 3
dds_full <- dds_full[keep, ]

cat("\nDESeq2 object after filtering:\n")
print(dim(dds_full))

# =========================
# 10) Run VST
# =========================

vsd_full <- vst(dds_full, blind = FALSE)

cat("\nVST dimensions:\n")
print(dim(assay(vsd_full)))

# =========================
# 11) Save cleaned objects
# =========================

saveRDS(
  dds_full,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/dds_full_Day1_3_5_7.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  vsd_full,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/vsd_full_Day1_3_5_7.rds"
)

write.csv(
  coldata_deseq,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/coldata_full_Day1_3_5_7.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(cts_deseq) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene"),
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/counts_full_Day1_3_5_7.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Pathway-level VST figures: OXPHOS + Glycolysis
# Corrected full Day 1/3/5/7 RNA-seq cohort
# =========================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# =========================
# 1) Use corrected full objects
# =========================

vsd <- vsd_full
coldata <- coldata_deseq

vst_mat <- assay(vsd)

# =========================
# 2) Annotate VST matrix
# =========================

vst_df <- as.data.frame(vst_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    SYMBOL = gene
  )

# Since this counts file is HGNC gene-symbol based,
# rownames are already gene symbols.
# If any duplicated symbols were made unique with ".1", remove suffix only if needed:
vst_df <- vst_df %>%
  mutate(
    SYMBOL_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", SYMBOL)
  )

# =========================
# 3) Metadata
# =========================

meta <- as.data.frame(coldata) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample_Name") %>%
  mutate(
    Day = as.character(Day),
    Status = as.character(Status)
  )

# =========================
# 4) Function to calculate pathway VST scores
# =========================

calculate_pathway_scores <- function(pathway_genes, pathway_name) {
  
  pathway_vst <- vst_df %>%
    filter(SYMBOL_clean %in% pathway_genes)
  
  cat(pathway_name, "genes found:", nrow(pathway_vst), "\n")
  
  pathway_scores <- pathway_vst %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, SYMBOL_clean, all_of(colnames(vst_mat))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(colnames(vst_mat)),
      names_to = "Sample_Name",
      values_to = "VST"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Sample_Name) %>%
    summarise(
      Pathway_VST_Score = mean(VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "Sample_Name") %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = pathway_name
    )
  
  return(pathway_scores)
}

# =========================
# 5) Calculate OXPHOS and Glycolysis scores
# =========================

oxphos_scores_full <- calculate_pathway_scores(
  oxphos_genes,
  "OXPHOS"
)

glycolysis_scores_full <- calculate_pathway_scores(
  glycolysis_genes,
  "Glycolysis"
)

# =========================
# 6) Function: Day 1 -> Day 3 line plot
# =========================

make_day1_day3_plot <- function(scores_df, pathway_name, y_label_text) {
  
  summary_df <- scores_df %>%
    filter(Day %in% c("1", "3")) %>%
    group_by(Status, Day) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_score = mean(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_score = sd(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Day = factor(
        Day,
        levels = c("1", "3"),
        labels = c("Day 1", "Day 3")
      )
    )
  
  print(summary_df)
  
  p <- ggplot(
    summary_df,
    aes(
      x = Day,
      y = mean_score,
      group = Status,
      color = Status
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_score - se_score,
        ymax = mean_score + se_score
      ),
      width = 0.12
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Early ", pathway_name, " Expression"),
      subtitle = "Corrected full Day 1/3/5/7 RNA-seq cohort",
      x = "",
      y = y_label_text,
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# =========================
# 7) Create OXPHOS and Glycolysis Day 1 -> Day 3 figures
# =========================

fig_oxphos_day1_day3_full <- make_day1_day3_plot(
  oxphos_scores_full,
  "OXPHOS",
  "Mean VST expression of Hallmark OXPHOS genes"
)

fig_glycolysis_day1_day3_full <- make_day1_day3_plot(
  glycolysis_scores_full,
  "Glycolysis",
  "Mean VST expression of Hallmark Glycolysis genes"
)

fig_oxphos_day1_day3_full
fig_glycolysis_day1_day3_full

# =========================
# 8) Save figures
# =========================

ggsave(
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/OXPHOS_Day1_Day3_FULL124.png",
  fig_oxphos_day1_day3_full,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Glycolysis_Day1_Day3_FULL124.png",
  fig_glycolysis_day1_day3_full,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

# =========================
# 9) Save pathway scores for later ΔVST analysis
# =========================

write.csv(
  oxphos_scores_full,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/OXPHOS_PathwayScores_FULL124.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  glycolysis_scores_full,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Glycolysis_PathwayScores_FULL124.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

# =========================
# 1) Read resolution table
# =========================

resolution_path <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Resolution_table.xlsx"

resolution_table <- read_excel(resolution_path)

resolution_table_clean <- resolution_table %>%
  filter(Include_in_Resolution_Analysis == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    Resolution_Sample_Name = clean_sample_id(Resolution_Sample_Name),
    Resolution_Group = factor(
      Resolution_Group,
      levels = c("Resolving_cleared", "Persistent_Resolution")
    )
  )

resolution_table_clean %>%
  count(Resolution_Group)

# =========================
# 2) Match to corrected full VST object
# =========================

vst_mat_full <- assay(vsd_full)

resolution_samples <- resolution_table_clean$Resolution_Sample_Name

matched_samples <- intersect(resolution_samples, colnames(vst_mat_full))
missing_samples <- setdiff(resolution_samples, colnames(vst_mat_full))

cat("Resolution samples in table:", length(resolution_samples), "\n")
cat("Matched samples in VST:", length(matched_samples), "\n")
cat("Missing samples:", length(missing_samples), "\n")

missing_samples

resolution_table_matched <- resolution_table_clean %>%
  filter(Resolution_Sample_Name %in% matched_samples)

resolution_table_matched %>%
  count(Resolution_Group)

# =========================
# 3) Function: resolution pathway boxplot
# =========================

make_resolution_pathway_plot <- function(pathway_genes, pathway_name, y_label_text, save_path) {
  
  pathway_vst <- as.data.frame(vst_mat_full) %>%
    rownames_to_column("SYMBOL") %>%
    mutate(
      SYMBOL_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", SYMBOL)
    ) %>%
    filter(SYMBOL_clean %in% pathway_genes)
  
  cat(pathway_name, "genes found:", nrow(pathway_vst), "\n")
  
  pathway_scores <- pathway_vst %>%
    dplyr::select(SYMBOL_clean, all_of(matched_samples)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(matched_samples),
      names_to = "Resolution_Sample_Name",
      values_to = "VST"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Resolution_Sample_Name) %>%
    summarise(
      Pathway_VST_Score = mean(VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      resolution_table_matched %>%
        dplyr::select(Resolution_Sample_Name, Resolution_Group),
      by = "Resolution_Sample_Name"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Resolution_Group = factor(
        Resolution_Group,
        levels = c("Resolving_cleared", "Persistent_Resolution"),
        labels = c("Resolving Day 3", "Persistent Resolution")
      )
    )
  
  print(
    pathway_scores %>%
      count(Resolution_Group)
  )
  
  print(
    pathway_scores %>%
      group_by(Resolution_Group) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_score = mean(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_score = median(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_score = sd(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  )
  
  print(
    wilcox.test(Pathway_VST_Score ~ Resolution_Group, data = pathway_scores)
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    pathway_scores,
    aes(
      x = Resolution_Group,
      y = Pathway_VST_Score,
      fill = Resolution_Group
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(pathway_name, " Expression at Bacteremia Resolution"),
      subtitle = "Resolving Day 3 versus Persistent patient-specific resolution samples",
      x = "",
      y = y_label_text
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    save_path,
    p,
    width = 6,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(pathway_scores)
}
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Create vsd_all: full 147-sample VST object
# For event-based resolution analyses
# =========================

library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Assumes these already exist from your full setup:
# cts_matched      = counts matrix with all 147 matched samples
# coldata_matched  = metadata with all 147 matched samples

# =========================
# 1) Prepare metadata
# =========================

coldata_all <- coldata_matched

rownames(coldata_all) <- coldata_all$Sample

coldata_all$Status <- factor(
  coldata_all$Status,
  levels = c("Persistent", "Resolving")
)

# Keep Day as factor because these are event/irregular timepoints
coldata_all$Day <- factor(coldata_all$Day)

# Confirm full cohort
cat("Full samples:", nrow(coldata_all), "\n")

coldata_all %>%
  distinct(Subject, Status) %>%
  count(Status)

coldata_all %>%
  count(Status, Day)

# =========================
# 2) Create DESeq2 object with all 147 samples
# =========================

dds_all <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = as.matrix(cts_matched),
  colData = coldata_all,
  design = ~ Status
)

# Note:
# design = ~ Status is sufficient for VST normalization used in pathway scoring.
# We are not using this object for time-course DE testing.

# =========================
# 3) Filter low-count genes
# =========================

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_all) >= 10) >= 3
dds_all <- dds_all[keep, ]

cat("dds_all dimensions after filtering:\n")
print(dim(dds_all))

# =========================
# 4) Run VST
# =========================

vsd_all <- vst(dds_all, blind = FALSE)

cat("vsd_all dimensions:\n")
print(dim(assay(vsd_all)))

# =========================
# 5) Save objects
# =========================

saveRDS(
  dds_all,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/dds_all_147samples.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  vsd_all,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/vsd_all_147samples.rds"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Resolution pathway VST analysis using vsd_all
# Creates/saves boxplots + Wilcoxon tests
# Pathways: OXPHOS and Glycolysis
# =========================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)

# =========================
# 1) Read resolution table
# =========================

resolution_path <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Resolution_table.xlsx"

resolution_table <- read_excel(resolution_path)

resolution_table_clean <- resolution_table %>%
  filter(Include_in_Resolution_Analysis == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    Resolution_Sample_Name = clean_sample_id(Resolution_Sample_Name),
    Resolution_Group = factor(
      Resolution_Group,
      levels = c("Resolving_cleared", "Persistent_Resolution")
    )
  )

resolution_table_clean %>%
  count(Resolution_Group)

# =========================
# 2) Match resolution samples to vsd_all
# =========================

vst_mat_all <- assay(vsd_all)

resolution_samples <- resolution_table_clean$Resolution_Sample_Name

matched_samples <- intersect(resolution_samples, colnames(vst_mat_all))
missing_samples <- setdiff(resolution_samples, colnames(vst_mat_all))

cat("Resolution samples in table:", length(resolution_samples), "\n")
cat("Matched samples in vsd_all:", length(matched_samples), "\n")
cat("Missing samples:", length(missing_samples), "\n")

missing_samples

resolution_table_matched <- resolution_table_clean %>%
  filter(Resolution_Sample_Name %in% matched_samples)

resolution_table_matched %>%
  count(Resolution_Group)

# =========================
# 3) Prepare VST dataframe
# =========================

vst_df_all <- as.data.frame(vst_mat_all) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", Gene)
  )

# =========================
# 4) Function to make resolution boxplot + Wilcoxon
# =========================

run_resolution_pathway <- function(pathway_genes,
                                   pathway_name,
                                   y_label,
                                   save_file) {
  
  pathway_vst <- vst_df_all %>%
    filter(Gene_clean %in% pathway_genes)
  
  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat(pathway_name, "\n")
  cat("=========================\n")
  cat("Genes found:", nrow(pathway_vst), "\n")
  
  pathway_scores <- pathway_vst %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_clean, all_of(matched_samples)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(matched_samples),
      names_to = "Resolution_Sample_Name",
      values_to = "VST"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Resolution_Sample_Name) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_VST = mean(VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      resolution_table_matched %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Resolution_Sample_Name,
          Resolution_Group
        ),
      by = "Resolution_Sample_Name"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Resolution_Group_Label = factor(
        Resolution_Group,
        levels = c("Resolving_cleared", "Persistent_Resolution"),
        labels = c("Resolving\nCleared", "Persistent\nResolution")
      )
    )
  
  # Summary stats
  summary_stats <- pathway_scores %>%
    group_by(Resolution_Group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(Mean_VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(Mean_VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(Mean_VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  print(summary_stats)
  
  # Wilcoxon rank-sum test
  wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(
    Mean_VST ~ Resolution_Group,
    data = pathway_scores,
    exact = FALSE
  )
  
  print(wilcox_result)
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(
    pathway_scores,
    aes(
      x = Resolution_Group_Label,
      y = Mean_VST,
      fill = Resolution_Group_Label
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.12,
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Resolving\nCleared" = "#66C2C4",     # blue
      "Persistent\nResolution" = "#E79A95"  # red
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(pathway_name, " Expression at Bacterial Resolution"),
    x = "",
    y = y_label
  ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = save_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 6,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(
    list(
      scores = pathway_scores,
      summary = summary_stats,
      wilcox = wilcox_result,
      plot = p
    )
  )
}

# =========================
# 5) Run OXPHOS
# =========================

oxphos_resolution_result <- run_resolution_pathway(
  pathway_genes = oxphos_genes,
  pathway_name = "OXPHOS",
  y_label = "Mean VST expression of Hallmark OXPHOS genes",
  save_file = "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/OXPHOS_Resolution_vsd_all.png"
)

# =========================
# 6) Run Glycolysis
# =========================

glycolysis_resolution_result <- run_resolution_pathway(
  pathway_genes = glycolysis_genes,
  pathway_name = "Glycolysis",
  y_label = "Mean VST expression of Hallmark Glycolysis genes",
  save_file = "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Glycolysis_Resolution_vsd_all.png"
)

# =========================
# 7) Export summary/statistics
# =========================

resolution_pathway_summary <- bind_rows(
  oxphos_resolution_result$summary %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = "OXPHOS",
      Wilcoxon_pvalue = oxphos_resolution_result$wilcox$p.value
    ),
  glycolysis_resolution_result$summary %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = "Glycolysis",
      Wilcoxon_pvalue = glycolysis_resolution_result$wilcox$p.value
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Pathway,
    Resolution_Group,
    n,
    mean,
    median,
    sd,
    Wilcoxon_pvalue
  )

write_xlsx(
  list(
    Summary = resolution_pathway_summary,
    OXPHOS_scores = oxphos_resolution_result$scores,
    Glycolysis_scores = glycolysis_resolution_result$scores
  ),
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Resolution_OXPHOS_Glycolysis_vsd_all_summary.xlsx"
)

resolution_pathway_summary
```

```{r}
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)

hallmark <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
)

inflammatory_genes <- hallmark %>%
  filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE") %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>%
  unique()

tnfa_genes <- hallmark %>%
  filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB") %>%
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Resolution-stage pathway figures for all pathways
# Uses vsd_all + Resolution_table.xlsx
# =========================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)

# =========================
# 1) Read and match resolution table
# =========================

resolution_path <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Resolution_table.xlsx"

resolution_table <- read_excel(resolution_path)

resolution_table_clean <- resolution_table %>%
  filter(Include_in_Resolution_Analysis == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    Resolution_Sample_Name = clean_sample_id(Resolution_Sample_Name),
    Resolution_Group = factor(
      Resolution_Group,
      levels = c("Resolving_cleared", "Persistent_Resolution")
    )
  )

vst_mat_all <- assay(vsd_all)

resolution_samples <- resolution_table_clean$Resolution_Sample_Name
matched_samples <- intersect(resolution_samples, colnames(vst_mat_all))

resolution_table_matched <- resolution_table_clean %>%
  filter(Resolution_Sample_Name %in% matched_samples)

resolution_table_matched %>%
  count(Resolution_Group)

# =========================
# 2) Prepare VST dataframe
# =========================

vst_df_all <- as.data.frame(vst_mat_all) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", Gene)
  )

# =========================
# 3) Function: resolution boxplot + Wilcoxon + save PNG
# =========================

run_resolution_pathway <- function(pathway_genes,
                                   pathway_name,
                                   y_label,
                                   save_file) {
  
  pathway_vst <- vst_df_all %>%
    filter(Gene_clean %in% pathway_genes)
  
  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat(pathway_name, "\n")
  cat("=========================\n")
  cat("Genes found:", nrow(pathway_vst), "\n")
  
  pathway_scores <- pathway_vst %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_clean, all_of(matched_samples)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(matched_samples),
      names_to = "Resolution_Sample_Name",
      values_to = "VST"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Resolution_Sample_Name) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_VST = mean(VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      resolution_table_matched %>%
        dplyr::select(Resolution_Sample_Name, Resolution_Group),
      by = "Resolution_Sample_Name"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Resolution_Group_Label = factor(
        Resolution_Group,
        levels = c("Resolving_cleared", "Persistent_Resolution"),
        labels = c("Resolving\nCleared", "Persistent\nResolution")
      )
    )
  
  summary_stats <- pathway_scores %>%
    group_by(Resolution_Group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(Mean_VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(Mean_VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(Mean_VST, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(
    Mean_VST ~ Resolution_Group,
    data = pathway_scores,
    exact = FALSE
  )
  
  print(summary_stats)
  print(wilcox_result)
  
  p <- ggplot(
    pathway_scores,
    aes(
      x = Resolution_Group_Label,
      y = Mean_VST,
      fill = Resolution_Group_Label
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.12,
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Resolving\nCleared" = "#66C2C4",
        "Persistent\nResolution" = "#E79A95"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(pathway_name, " Expression at Bacterial Resolution"),
      x = "",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = save_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 6,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(
    list(
      scores = pathway_scores,
      summary = summary_stats,
      wilcox = wilcox_result,
      plot = p,
      genes_found = nrow(pathway_vst)
    )
  )
}

# =========================
# 4) Run all resolution-stage pathways
# =========================

res_oxphos <- run_resolution_pathway(
  oxphos_genes,
  "OXPHOS",
  "Mean VST expression of Hallmark OXPHOS genes",
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Resolution_OXPHOS_vsd_all.png"
```

```{r}
#Calculating Delta change between Day 3 and Day 1 across few pathways 
# =========================
# Group-level Day 1 -> Day 3 slopes
# Uses ALL available Day 1 and Day 3 samples
# Not paired patient analysis
# =========================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)

calculate_group_slope <- function(pathway_df, pathway_name) {
  
  group_summary <- pathway_df %>%
    filter(Day %in% c("1", "3")) %>%
    group_by(Status, Day) %>%
    summarise(
      n_samples = n(),
      mean_vst = mean(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_vst = median(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_vst = sd(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_vst = sd_vst / sqrt(n_samples),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Day = as.character(Day)
    )
  
  # Wide format for slope calculation
  wide_summary <- group_summary %>%
    select(Status, Day, n_samples, mean_vst, median_vst, se_vst) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Day,
      values_from = c(n_samples, mean_vst, median_vst, se_vst),
      names_sep = "_Day"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = pathway_name,
      
      # Change in group mean from Day 1 to Day 3
      Delta_mean_VST = mean_vst_Day3 - mean_vst_Day1,
      
      # Change per day; Day 3 - Day 1 = 2 days
      Slope_per_day = Delta_mean_VST / 2,
      
      # Median change as a sensitivity metric
      Delta_median_VST = median_vst_Day3 - median_vst_Day1
    ) %>%
    select(
      Pathway,
      Status,
      n_Day1 = n_samples_Day1,
      n_Day3 = n_samples_Day3,
      mean_Day1 = mean_vst_Day1,
      mean_Day3 = mean_vst_Day3,
      Delta_mean_VST,
      Slope_per_day,
      median_Day1 = median_vst_Day1,
      median_Day3 = median_vst_Day3,
      Delta_median_VST,
      se_Day1 = se_vst_Day1,
      se_Day3 = se_vst_Day3
    )
  
  return(wide_summary)
}

# =========================
# Run group-level slope table for all pathways
# =========================

group_slope_results <- bind_rows(
  calculate_group_slope(oxphos_scores_full, "OXPHOS"),
  calculate_group_slope(glycolysis_scores_full, "Glycolysis"),
  calculate_group_slope(inflammatory_scores_full, "Inflammatory Response"),
  calculate_group_slope(tnfa_scores_full, "TNFA/NFKB Signaling"),
  calculate_group_slope(ifng_scores_full, "IFNG Response"),
  calculate_group_slope(ros_scores_full, "Reactive Oxygen Species"),
  calculate_group_slope(complement_scores_full, "Complement"),
  calculate_group_slope(coagulation_scores_full, "Coagulation")
) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_Day1 = round(mean_Day1, 4),
    mean_Day3 = round(mean_Day3, 4),
    Delta_mean_VST = round(Delta_mean_VST, 4),
    Slope_per_day = round(Slope_per_day, 4),
    median_Day1 = round(median_Day1, 4),
    median_Day3 = round(median_Day3, 4),
    Delta_median_VST = round(Delta_median_VST, 4),
    se_Day1 = round(se_Day1, 4),
    se_Day3 = round(se_Day3, 4)
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

calculate_day_wilcox <- function(pathway_df, pathway_name) {
  
  results <- pathway_df %>%
    filter(Day %in% c("1", "3")) %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      
      test <- wilcox.test(
        Pathway_VST_Score ~ Status,
        data = .x,
        exact = FALSE
      )
      
      summary <- .x %>%
        group_by(Status) %>%
        summarize(
          n = n(),
          mean_VST = mean(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_VST = median(Pathway_VST_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      
      data.frame(
        Persistent_n = summary$n[summary$Status == "Persistent"],
        Persistent_mean = summary$mean_VST[summary$Status == "Persistent"],
        Persistent_median = summary$median_VST[summary$Status == "Persistent"],
        
        Resolving_n = summary$n[summary$Status == "Resolving"],
        Resolving_mean = summary$mean_VST[summary$Status == "Resolving"],
        Resolving_median = summary$median_VST[summary$Status == "Resolving"],
        
        Wilcoxon_p = test$p.value
      )
    }) %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = pathway_name
    ) %>%
    select(
      Pathway,
      Day,
      Persistent_n,
      Persistent_mean,
      Persistent_median,
      Resolving_n,
      Resolving_mean,
      Resolving_median,
      Wilcoxon_p
    )
  
  return(results)
}


day_comparison_results <- bind_rows(
  calculate_day_wilcox(oxphos_scores_full, "OXPHOS"),
  calculate_day_wilcox(glycolysis_scores_full, "Glycolysis"),
  calculate_day_wilcox(inflammatory_scores_full, "Inflammatory Response"),
  calculate_day_wilcox(tnfa_scores_full, "TNFA/NFKB Signaling"),
  calculate_day_wilcox(ifng_scores_full, "IFNG Response"),
  calculate_day_wilcox(ros_scores_full, "Reactive Oxygen Species"),
  calculate_day_wilcox(complement_scores_full, "Complement"),
  calculate_day_wilcox(coagulation_scores_full, "Coagulation")
)

write.csv(
  day_comparison_results,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Day1_Day3_Wilcoxon_Pathway_Comparison.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Gene-level DESeq2 pathway extraction
# Comparison 1: Day 1 Persistent vs Resolving
# =========================

library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(writexl)

# =========================
# 1) Create pathway annotation table
# =========================

pathway_annotation <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(Gene = oxphos_genes, Pathway = "OXPHOS"),
  data.frame(Gene = glycolysis_genes, Pathway = "Glycolysis"),
  data.frame(Gene = inflammatory_genes, Pathway = "Inflammatory Response"),
  data.frame(Gene = tnfa_genes, Pathway = "TNFA/NFKB Signaling"),
  data.frame(Gene = ifng_genes, Pathway = "IFNG Response"),
  data.frame(Gene = ros_genes, Pathway = "Reactive Oxygen Species"),
  data.frame(Gene = complement_genes, Pathway = "Complement"),
  data.frame(Gene = coagulation_genes, Pathway = "Coagulation")
) %>%
  distinct()

pathway_annotation %>%
  count(Pathway)

# =========================
# 2) Day 1 subset
# =========================

coldata_day1 <- coldata_deseq %>%
  filter(Day == "1")

cts_day1 <- cts_deseq[, coldata_day1$Sample, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(cts_day1), coldata_day1$Sample))

rownames(coldata_day1) <- coldata_day1$Sample

cat("Day 1 samples:\n")
print(table(coldata_day1$Status))

# =========================
# 3) DESeq2 object for Day 1
# =========================

coldata_day1$Status <- factor(
  coldata_day1$Status,
  levels = c("Resolving", "Persistent")
)

dds_day1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = as.matrix(cts_day1),
  colData = coldata_day1,
  design = ~ Status
)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_day1) >= 10) >= 3
dds_day1 <- dds_day1[keep, ]

cat("Day 1 DESeq2 dimensions after filtering:\n")
print(dim(dds_day1))

# Run DESeq2
dds_day1 <- DESeq(dds_day1)

# Persistent vs Resolving
res_day1 <- results(
  dds_day1,
  contrast = c("Status", "Persistent", "Resolving")
)

day1_full <- as.data.frame(res_day1) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", Gene),
    Comparison = "Day1_Persistent_vs_Resolving",
    Direction = case_when(
      log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Higher in Persistent",
      log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Higher in Resolving",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

# =========================
# 4) Extract pathway genes only
# =========================

day1_pathway_results <- day1_full %>%
  inner_join(
    pathway_annotation,
    by = c("Gene_clean" = "Gene")
  ) %>%
  arrange(pvalue)

# =========================
# 5) Summary counts
# =========================

cat("Total pathway rows extracted:", nrow(day1_pathway_results), "\n")

day1_pathway_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(pvalue), pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  count(Pathway, Direction) %>%
  arrange(Pathway, Direction)

cat("Nominal p < 0.05 pathway genes:",
    sum(day1_pathway_results$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("padj < 0.05 pathway genes:",
    sum(day1_pathway_results$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# =========================
# 6) Save Day 1 results
# =========================

write_xlsx(
  list(
    Day1_All_Pathway_Genes = day1_pathway_results,
    Day1_Nominal_p05 = day1_pathway_results %>%
      filter(!is.na(pvalue), pvalue < 0.05),
    Pathway_Annotation = pathway_annotation
  ),
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Day1_Pathway_DESeq2_Results.xlsx"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# GSVA + limma pathway analysis
# Hallmark pathways: 8 selected pathways
# =========================

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(GSVA)
library(limma)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# =========================
# 1) Define pathway list
# =========================

pathway_list <- list(
  OXPHOS = oxphos_genes,
  Glycolysis = glycolysis_genes,
  Inflammatory_Response = inflammatory_genes,
  TNFA_NFKB = tnfa_genes,
  IFNG_Response = ifng_genes,
  Reactive_Oxygen_Species = ros_genes,
  Complement = complement_genes,
  Coagulation = coagulation_genes
)

# =========================
# Function: GSVA + limma
# Compatible with GSVA v2.4.4
# =========================

run_gsva_limma <- function(vst_mat,
                           metadata,
                           group_col,
                           group_ref,
                           group_test,
                           comparison_name) {
  
  library(GSVA)
  library(limma)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  
  # -------------------------
  # Clean gene names
  # -------------------------
  
  rownames(vst_mat) <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(vst_mat))
  
  # Remove duplicate genes
  vst_mat <- vst_mat[!duplicated(rownames(vst_mat)), ]
  
  # -------------------------
  # Match pathway genes
  # -------------------------
  
  pathway_list_present <- lapply(
    pathway_list,
    function(x) intersect(x, rownames(vst_mat))
  )
  
  cat("\nGenes found per pathway:\n")
  print(sapply(pathway_list_present, length))
  
  
  # -------------------------
  # GSVA (new syntax)
  # -------------------------
  
  gsva_params <- gsvaParam(
    exprData = vst_mat,
    geneSets = pathway_list_present,
    kcdf = "Gaussian",
    maxDiff = TRUE
  )
  
  gsva_scores <- gsva(
    gsva_params,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------
  # Prepare metadata
  # -------------------------
  
  metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)
  
  metadata[[group_col]] <- factor(
    metadata[[group_col]],
    levels = c(group_ref, group_test)
  )
  
  metadata <- metadata[colnames(gsva_scores), , drop = FALSE]
  
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(gsva_scores),
      rownames(metadata)
    )
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------
  # limma model
  # -------------------------
  
  design <- model.matrix(
    as.formula(
      paste0("~0 + ", group_col)
    ),
    data = metadata
  )
  
  colnames(design) <- levels(metadata[[group_col]])
  
  
  fit <- lmFit(gsva_scores, design)
  
  
  contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
    contrasts = paste0(group_test, "-", group_ref),
    levels = design
  )
  
  
  fit2 <- contrasts.fit(
    fit,
    contrast_matrix
  )
  
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
  
  
  # -------------------------
  # Extract results
  # -------------------------
  
  results <- topTable(
    fit2,
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Pathway") %>%
    mutate(
      Comparison = comparison_name,
      Direction = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~ paste("Higher in", group_test),
        logFC < 0 ~ paste("Higher in", group_ref),
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Comparison,
      Pathway,
      logFC,
      AveExpr,
      t,
      P.Value,
      adj.P.Val,
      B,
      Direction
    )
  
  
  return(
    list(
      gsva_scores = gsva_scores,
      results = results
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Combine all nominal p < 0.05 Hallmark results
# -----------------------------

all_hallmark <- bind_rows(
  day1_nominal %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = "Day 1"),
  day3_nominal %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = "Day 3"),
  resolution_nominal %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = "Resolution")
) %>%
  distinct(Gene_clean, Pathway, Direction, Timepoint)

# Check counts match prior table
all_hallmark %>%
  count(Timepoint, Direction)

all_hallmark %>%
  count(Timepoint, Pathway)


# -----------------------------
# 2. Function to calculate overlap summary
# -----------------------------

calculate_overlap <- function(df, direction_label) {
  
  df_dir <- df %>%
    filter(Direction == direction_label) %>%
    distinct(Pathway, Timepoint, Gene_clean)
  
  pathway_list <- sort(unique(df_dir$Pathway))
  
  map_dfr(pathway_list, function(pw) {
    
    d <- df_dir %>% filter(Pathway == pw)
    
    genes_d1  <- d %>% filter(Timepoint == "Day 1") %>% pull(Gene_clean) %>% unique()
    genes_d3  <- d %>% filter(Timepoint == "Day 3") %>% pull(Gene_clean) %>% unique()
    genes_res <- d %>% filter(Timepoint == "Resolution") %>% pull(Gene_clean) %>% unique()
    
    total_unique <- unique(c(genes_d1, genes_d3, genes_res))
    
    shared_d1_d3  <- intersect(genes_d1, genes_d3)
    shared_d1_res <- intersect(genes_d1, genes_res)
    shared_d3_res <- intersect(genes_d3, genes_res)
    shared_all3   <- Reduce(intersect, list(genes_d1, genes_d3, genes_res))
    
    unique_d1 <- setdiff(genes_d1, union(genes_d3, genes_res))
    unique_d3 <- setdiff(genes_d3, union(genes_d1, genes_res))
    unique_res <- setdiff(genes_res, union(genes_d1, genes_d3))
    
    tibble(
      Direction = direction_label,
      Pathway = pw,
      Total_Unique_Genes = length(total_unique),
      Shared_Day1_Day3 = length(shared_d1_d3),
      Shared_Day1_Resolution = length(shared_d1_res),
      Shared_Day3_Resolution = length(shared_d3_res),
      Shared_All_3 = length(shared_all3),
      Unique_Day1 = length(unique_d1),
      Unique_Day3 = length(unique_d3),
      Unique_Resolution = length(unique_res),
      Shared_All_3_Genes = paste(sort(shared_all3), collapse = ", "),
      Shared_Day1_Day3_Genes = paste(sort(shared_d1_d3), collapse = ", "),
      Shared_Day1_Resolution_Genes = paste(sort(shared_d1_res), collapse = ", "),
      Shared_Day3_Resolution_Genes = paste(sort(shared_d3_res), collapse = ", ")
    )
  })
}


# -----------------------------
# 3. Run separately for Persistent and Resolving
# -----------------------------

persistent_overlap <- calculate_overlap(
  all_hallmark,
  "Higher in Persistent"
)

resolving_overlap <- calculate_overlap(
  all_hallmark,
  "Higher in Resolving"
)

overlap_summary <- bind_rows(
  persistent_overlap,
  resolving_overlap
)


# -----------------------------
# 4. Cleaner count-only table for Annie
# -----------------------------

overlap_counts <- overlap_summary %>%
  select(
    Direction,
    Pathway,
    Total_Unique_Genes,
    Shared_Day1_Day3,
    Shared_Day1_Resolution,
    Shared_Day3_Resolution,
    Shared_All_3,
    Unique_Day1,
    Unique_Day3,
    Unique_Resolution
  )


# -----------------------------
# 5. Gene-list table for follow-up
# -----------------------------

overlap_gene_lists <- overlap_summary %>%
  select(
    Direction,
    Pathway,
    Shared_All_3_Genes,
    Shared_Day1_Day3_Genes,
    Shared_Day1_Resolution_Genes,
    Shared_Day3_Resolution_Genes
  )


# -----------------------------
# 6. Optional: make pattern table per gene
# -----------------------------

gene_pattern_table <- all_hallmark %>%
  mutate(Present = 1) %>%
  unite("Condition", Timepoint, Direction, sep = "_") %>%
  distinct(Gene_clean, Pathway, Condition, Present) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Condition,
    values_from = Present,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(Pathway, Gene_clean)


# -----------------------------
# 7. Export to Excel
# -----------------------------

write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Overlap_Counts" = overlap_counts,
    "Overlap_Gene_Lists" = overlap_gene_lists,
    "Gene_Pattern_Table" = gene_pattern_table
  ),
  file = "Hallmark_Pathway_Longitudinal_Overlap.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

calculate_transition <- function(df, direction_label,
                                 tp1 = "Day 1",
                                 tp2 = "Day 3") {

  df_dir <- df %>%
    filter(Direction == direction_label)

  pathways <- sort(unique(df$Pathway))

  map_dfr(pathways, function(pw){

    g1 <- df_dir %>%
      filter(Pathway == pw,
             Timepoint == tp1) %>%
      pull(Gene_clean) %>%
      unique()

    g2 <- df_dir %>%
      filter(Pathway == pw,
             Timepoint == tp2) %>%
      pull(Gene_clean) %>%
      unique()

    shared <- intersect(g1, g2)

    lost <- setdiff(g1, g2)

    gained <- setdiff(g2, g1)

    tibble(
      Direction = direction_label,
      Pathway = pw,

      Genes_Time1 = length(g1),
      Genes_Time2 = length(g2),

      Shared = length(shared),
      Lost = length(lost),
      Gained = length(gained),

      Percent_Time1_Retained =
        round(100*length(shared)/max(length(g1),1),1),

      Percent_Time2_New =
        round(100*length(gained)/max(length(g2),1),1),

      Shared_Genes = paste(shared, collapse=", ")
    )

  })

}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

get_shared_genes <- function(df, direction,
                             tp1,
                             tp2){

  df_dir <- df %>%
    filter(Direction == direction)

  pathways <- sort(unique(df$Pathway))

  map_dfr(pathways, function(p){

    genes1 <- df_dir %>%
      filter(Pathway == p,
             Timepoint == tp1) %>%
      pull(Gene_clean) %>%
      unique()

    genes2 <- df_dir %>%
      filter(Pathway == p,
             Timepoint == tp2) %>%
      pull(Gene_clean) %>%
      unique()

    shared <- intersect(genes1, genes2)

    tibble(
      Pathway = p,
      Shared_n = length(shared),
      Shared_Genes = ifelse(length(shared)==0,
                            "-",
                            paste(sort(shared), collapse = "; "))
    )

  })

}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Combine nominal p < 0.05 Hallmark pathway results
#------------------------------------------------------------

all_hallmark <- bind_rows(
  day1_pathway_results %>%
    filter(pvalue < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = "Day 1"),
  
  day3_pathway_results %>%
    filter(pvalue < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = "Day 3"),
  
  resolution_pathway_results %>%
    filter(pvalue < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = "Resolution")
) %>%
  distinct(Gene_clean, Pathway, Direction, Timepoint)

# Quick checks
all_hallmark %>% count(Timepoint)
all_hallmark %>% count(Timepoint, Direction)


#------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Function for shared genes between adjacent phases
#------------------------------------------------------------

get_transition_shared <- function(df,
                                  direction_time1,
                                  direction_time2,
                                  transition_label,
                                  timepoint1,
                                  timepoint2,
                                  output_direction_label) {
  
  pathways <- sort(unique(df$Pathway))
  
  map_dfr(pathways, function(pw) {
    
    genes_t1 <- df %>%
      filter(
        Pathway == pw,
        Timepoint == timepoint1,
        Direction == direction_time1
      ) %>%
      pull(Gene_clean) %>%
      unique()
    
    genes_t2 <- df %>%
      filter(
        Pathway == pw,
        Timepoint == timepoint2,
        Direction == direction_time2
      ) %>%
      pull(Gene_clean) %>%
      unique()
    
    shared_genes <- intersect(genes_t1, genes_t2)
    
    tibble(
      Pathway = pw,
      Direction = output_direction_label,
      Transition = transition_label,
      Genes_Time1 = length(genes_t1),
      Genes_Time2 = length(genes_t2),
      Shared = length(shared_genes),
      Shared_Genes = ifelse(
        length(shared_genes) == 0,
        "—",
        paste(sort(shared_genes), collapse = "; ")
      )
    )
  })
}


#------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run all four transitions with correct direction labels
#------------------------------------------------------------

persistent_D1_D3 <- get_transition_shared(
  df = all_hallmark,
  direction_time1 = "Higher in Persistent",
  direction_time2 = "Higher in Persistent",
  transition_label = "Day 1 → Day 3",
  timepoint1 = "Day 1",
  timepoint2 = "Day 3",
  output_direction_label = "Persistent"
)

persistent_D3_Res <- get_transition_shared(
  df = all_hallmark,
  direction_time1 = "Higher in Persistent",
  direction_time2 = "Higher in Persistent_Resolution",
  transition_label = "Day 3 → Resolution",
  timepoint1 = "Day 3",
  timepoint2 = "Resolution",
  output_direction_label = "Persistent"
)

resolving_D1_D3 <- get_transition_shared(
  df = all_hallmark,
  direction_time1 = "Higher in Resolving",
  direction_time2 = "Higher in Resolving",
  transition_label = "Day 1 → Day 3",
  timepoint1 = "Day 1",
  timepoint2 = "Day 3",
  output_direction_label = "Resolving"
)

resolving_D3_Res <- get_transition_shared(
  df = all_hallmark,
  direction_time1 = "Higher in Resolving",
  direction_time2 = "Higher in Resolving_cleared",
  transition_label = "Day 3 → Resolution",
  timepoint1 = "Day 3",
  timepoint2 = "Resolution",
  output_direction_label = "Resolving"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Combine and clean table
#------------------------------------------------------------

transition_table_one_sheet <- bind_rows(
  persistent_D1_D3,
  persistent_D3_Res,
  resolving_D1_D3,
  resolving_D3_Res
)

clean_transition_table <- transition_table_one_sheet %>%
  mutate(
    `Day 1` = ifelse(
      Transition == "Day 1 → Day 3",
      Genes_Time1,
      NA
    ),
    
    `Day 3` = ifelse(
      Transition == "Day 1 → Day 3",
      Genes_Time2,
      Genes_Time1
    ),
    
    Resolution = ifelse(
      Transition == "Day 3 → Resolution",
      Genes_Time2,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Pathway,
    Direction,
    Transition,
    `Day 1`,
    `Day 3`,
    Resolution,
    `Shared (n)` = Shared,
    `Gene Symbols` = Shared_Genes
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Pathway,
    factor(Direction, levels = c("Persistent", "Resolving")),
    factor(Transition, levels = c("Day 1 → Day 3", "Day 3 → Resolution"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Day 1` = ifelse(is.na(`Day 1`), "—", as.character(`Day 1`)),
    `Day 3` = as.character(`Day 3`),
    Resolution = ifelse(is.na(Resolution), "—", as.character(Resolution))
  )


#------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Export formatted Excel file
#------------------------------------------------------------

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Shared_Genes_Table")

writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "Shared_Genes_Table",
  clean_transition_table
)

header_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  halign = "center",
  valign = "center",
  fgFill = "#D9EAF7",
  border = "Bottom"
)

addStyle(
  wb,
  sheet = "Shared_Genes_Table",
  style = header_style,
  rows = 1,
  cols = 1:ncol(clean_transition_table),
  gridExpand = TRUE
)

wrap_style <- createStyle(
  wrapText = TRUE,
  valign = "top"
)

addStyle(
  wb,
  sheet = "Shared_Genes_Table",
  style = wrap_style,
  rows = 2:(nrow(clean_transition_table) + 1),
  cols = 1:ncol(clean_transition_table),
  gridExpand = TRUE
)

setColWidths(wb, "Shared_Genes_Table", cols = 1, widths = 24)
setColWidths(wb, "Shared_Genes_Table", cols = 2, widths = 14)
setColWidths(wb, "Shared_Genes_Table", cols = 3, widths = 20)
setColWidths(wb, "Shared_Genes_Table", cols = 4:7, widths = 12)
setColWidths(wb, "Shared_Genes_Table", cols = 8, widths = 75)

freezePane(
  wb,
  "Shared_Genes_Table",
  firstRow = TRUE
)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/Hallmark_Shared_Genes_Clean_Table_UPDATED.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

clean_transition_table
```

```{r}
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    breaks = names(group_colors),
    labels = group_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 90),
    breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Immune and inflammatory pathways",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of upregulated\nHallmark pathway-associated genes"
  ) +
  shared_theme

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Panel B: metabolic pathways
# --------------------------------------------------

p_metabolic <- ggplot(
  metabolic_df,
  aes(
    x = Pathway,
    y = Gene_Count,
    fill = Group_Stage
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.82),
    width = 0.72,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Gene_Count),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.82),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    breaks = names(group_colors),
    labels = group_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 90),
    breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Metabolic pathways",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  shared_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank()
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Combine panels
# --------------------------------------------------

figure_1 <- (
  p_immune + p_metabolic +
    plot_layout(
      widths = c(1.6, 1),
      guides = "collect"
    )
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  ) &
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )

figure_1

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save figure
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "/Users/Chhugani/Downloads/Figure1_Hallmark_Pathways_TwoPanels_Clean.png",
  plot = figure_1,
  width = 14,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "/Users/Chhugani/Downloads/Figure1_Hallmark_Pathways_TwoPanels_Clean.pdf",
  plot = figure_1,
  width = 14,
  height = 7,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Keep only classified patients
# --------------------------------------------------

patient_table1 <- patient_table1 %>%
  filter(
    persistent_or_resolving %in% c("Persistent", "Resolving")
  )

# Confirm final cohort
table(patient_table1$persistent_or_resolving)
nrow(patient_table1)

table1_data <- patient_table1 %>%
  transmute(
    status = factor(
      str_trim(persistent_or_resolving),
      levels = c("Resolving", "Persistent")
    ),

    # Demographics
    age = as.numeric(age),

    sex = factor(
      str_trim(sex),
      levels = c("Male", "Female")
    ),

    # Microbiology
    microbiology = factor(
      str_trim(mrsa_mssa),
      levels = c("MSSA", "MRSA")
    ),

    # Source risk
    source_risk = case_when(
      str_detect(
        source_risk_category_low_medium_high,
        regex("^Low", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Low",

      str_detect(
        source_risk_category_low_medium_high,
        regex("^Intermediate|^Medium", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Intermediate",

      str_detect(
        source_risk_category_low_medium_high,
        regex("^High", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "High",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Top three comorbidities
    hypertension = case_when(
      str_detect(
        comorbidities,
        regex("(^|,\\s*)HTN($|,)|hypertension", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),

    diabetes_mellitus = case_when(
      str_detect(
        comorbidities,
        regex("diabetes|\\bDM\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),

    renal_disease = case_when(
      str_detect(
        comorbidities,
        regex(
          "renal disease|kidney disease|\\bCKD\\b|\\bESRD\\b",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),

    # Day 1 laboratory values
    platelet_count = parse_number(
      as.character(platelet_day1)
    ),

    neutrophil_percent = parse_number(
      as.character(neutrophil_percent_day1)
    ),

    lymphocyte_percent = parse_number(
      as.character(lymphocyte_percent_day1)
    ),

    monocyte_percent = parse_number(
      as.character(monocyte_percent_day1)
    ),

    # Clinical characteristics
    icu_stay = case_when(
      str_detect(
        icu_stay,
        regex("^Yes", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Yes",

      str_detect(
        icu_stay,
        regex("^No", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "No",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    duration_bacteremia = as.numeric(
      duration_of_bacteremia
    ),

    # Outcomes
    mortality_30_day = case_when(
      str_detect(
        x30_day_mortality,
        regex("^Yes", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Yes",

      str_detect(
        x30_day_mortality,
        regex("^No", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "No",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    mortality_90_day = case_when(
      str_detect(
        x90_day_mortality,
        regex("^Yes", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Yes",

      str_detect(
        x90_day_mortality,
        regex("^No", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "No",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    source_risk = factor(
      source_risk,
      levels = c("Low", "Intermediate", "High")
    ),

    hypertension = factor(
      hypertension,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    diabetes_mellitus = factor(
      diabetes_mellitus,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    renal_disease = factor(
      renal_disease,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    icu_stay = factor(
      icu_stay,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    mortality_30_day = factor(
      mortality_30_day,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    mortality_90_day = factor(
      mortality_90_day,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  )

glimpse(table1_data)

table(table1_data$status)

table(table1_data$microbiology, useNA = "ifany")

table(table1_data$source_risk, useNA = "ifany")

table1_data %>%
  summarise(
    hypertension = sum(hypertension == "Yes"),
    diabetes_mellitus = sum(diabetes_mellitus == "Yes"),
    renal_disease = sum(renal_disease == "Yes")
  )

table1_data %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(
    total_patients = n(),
    platelet_available = sum(!is.na(platelet_count)),
    neutrophil_available = sum(!is.na(neutrophil_percent)),
    lymphocyte_available = sum(!is.na(lymphocyte_percent)),
    monocyte_available = sum(!is.na(monocyte_percent))
  )
```

```{r}
        platelet_count,
        neutrophil_percent,
```

```{r}
        monocyte_percent,

    ),

    pvalue_fun = label_style_pvalue(digits = 3)

  ) %>%

  modify_header(
    label ~ "**Patient characteristics**",
    stat_1 ~ "**Resolving**\nN = {n}",
    stat_2 ~ "**Persistent**\nN = {n}",
    p.value ~ "**P value**"
  ) %>%

  bold_labels()
```

```{r}
    icu_48h = factor(icu_48h, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

table(table1_data$icu_48h, useNA = "ifany")

table(
  table1_data$status,
  table1_data$icu_48h,
  useNA = "ifany"
)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Verify pathway-member entries vs unique genes
# ==========================================================

library(dplyr)

# Significant pathway genes only
day1_sig <- day1_pathway_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(pvalue), pvalue < 0.05)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Overall counts
# ----------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Overall counts\n")
cat("==============================\n")

cat("Total pathway-member gene entries:",
    nrow(day1_sig), "\n")

cat("Unique genes:",
    n_distinct(day1_sig$Gene_clean), "\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Persistent
# ----------------------------------------------------------

persistent_sig <- day1_sig %>%
  filter(Direction == "Higher in Persistent")

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Higher in Persistent\n")
cat("==============================\n")

cat("Pathway-member gene entries:",
    nrow(persistent_sig), "\n")

cat("Unique genes:",
    n_distinct(persistent_sig$Gene_clean), "\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Resolving
# ----------------------------------------------------------

resolving_sig <- day1_sig %>%
  filter(Direction == "Higher in Resolving")

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Higher in Resolving\n")
cat("==============================\n")

cat("Pathway-member gene entries:",
    nrow(resolving_sig), "\n")

cat("Unique genes:",
    n_distinct(resolving_sig$Gene_clean), "\n")

# ==========================================================
# Counts by pathway
# ==========================================================

persistent_counts <- persistent_sig %>%
  count(Pathway, name = "Gene_entries") %>%
  arrange(desc(Gene_entries))

resolving_counts <- resolving_sig %>%
  count(Pathway, name = "Gene_entries") %>%
  arrange(desc(Gene_entries))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Persistent pathway counts\n")
cat("==============================\n")

print(persistent_counts)

cat("\nSum:",
    sum(persistent_counts$Gene_entries), "\n")

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Resolving pathway counts\n")
cat("==============================\n")

print(resolving_counts)

cat("\nSum:",
    sum(resolving_counts$Gene_entries), "\n")

# ==========================================================
# Complement pathway verification
# ==========================================================

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Resolving - Complement pathway\n")
cat("==============================\n")

resolving_sig %>%
  filter(Pathway == "Complement") %>%
  arrange(Gene_clean) %>%
  select(Gene_clean,
         log2FoldChange,
         pvalue,
         padj) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("\nComplement summary\n")

resolving_sig %>%
  filter(Pathway == "Complement") %>%
  summarise(
    Gene_entries = n(),
    Unique_genes = n_distinct(Gene_clean)
  ) %>%
  print()

# ==========================================================
# Genes present in multiple Hallmark pathways
# ==========================================================

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Persistent genes in multiple pathways\n")
cat("==============================\n")

persistent_sig %>%
  group_by(Gene_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_pathways = n_distinct(Pathway),
    Pathways = paste(sort(unique(Pathway)),
                     collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Number_of_pathways > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(Number_of_pathways), Gene_clean) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Resolving genes in multiple pathways\n")
cat("==============================\n")

resolving_sig %>%
  group_by(Gene_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_pathways = n_distinct(Pathway),
    Pathways = paste(sort(unique(Pathway)),
                     collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Number_of_pathways > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(Number_of_pathways), Gene_clean) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
